definitions.ask: Run sase-telegram CI daily (plus manual dispatch) so sase-master drift surfaces within a day?
definitions.why: this breakage sat unseen for 14 days and scheduled minutes are free on a public repo

choices.label: Add a daily cron and workflow_dispatch to ci.yml; free on a public repo, red runs send email
Leave ci.yml untouched; drift stays hidden until the next sase-telegram push
